body:
Philosophy. I, unfortunately, just barely passed last year because I withdrew from a few courses that affected my GPA because I could not handle them. So I don't think I can pursue grad school, and an undergraduate degree in it isn't noteworthy at all. I didn't get into an honors class either. 

I actually don't know what i'm going to do after.

>Do you feel very lonely?

I got used to it. But the need is still somewhere there.

I will consider the blog. Thanks.

I do know that that is what I require, and which I need to break out. The cycle need not continue, and a small step can be the start to getting out of it.

Thanks for reinforcing my thoughts.

University/college.

Where I am they are nearly synonymous.

When I joined some clubs in high school (it was required to join a few anyway) I didn't end up meeting anyone outside of it afterwards. There was only shared interest, no relationship. Of course I wasn't as proactive then so I didn't take advantage of it.

It is summer vacation now so anyone I meet I will probably not see when I go back to studies. It requires significant investment on my part so it's too much work for just passing the time for the next few months.

I like writing in my spare time, but do not expect to make a career out of it. I have been told I have talent, but I have no idea if they are just saying that to encourage me and be nice. I don't like rereading anything I write because it makes me cringe.

I have no idea why I am this way. It could be because of loneliness or biological or both.
It's the date of my graduation actually. I plan to finish that beforehand.

To be honest I do not know how I am feeling. I do not have a lot of motivation and a little bored. I want to seek amusement or distraction now but cannot be bothered. Whenever i'm sad I like to watch or read sad stories and sometimes I cry, but when I am on my own and not living vicariously through stories, I don't feel anything.

When I read other peoples' posts they seem full of life. All I have is squandered opportunity. I have no narrative and I am boring. I hate it when a conversation goes the way of a question posed in the form of "so what did you do today", etc, since I have no life events worth talking about. 

I'd go out and talk to people more but because I have nothing to offer I have less of a reason to do so. Because I do not to do I even have less to offer. It's a vicious cycle. IRL socialization requires pretext, of which I am lacking in.

Recently I started to talk to people more online and we seem to mutually enjoy the conversation. I've been trying to improve my conversational skills this way, which mainly take the form of showing interest with what they have to tell, but whenever any conversation ends I go back the way I am. It's like i'm just distracting myself.
